cover-1.title: Porsche Cover | Baasim Fayaz Khan
cover-1.desc: Porsche 911 GT3 RS cover design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
cover-1.h2: PORSCHE 911 GT3 RS â€” Automotive Art
paras: This cover was designed to capture the aerodynamic soul of the Porsche 911 GT3 RS. The layout focuses on cinematic lighting and high-clarity textures to emphasize the precision engineering of the vehicle.
The monochromatic aesthetic with subtle blue-hour tones creates a sophisticated, premium feel. Typography was kept minimal and sharp to mirror the car's aggressive performance lines.

cover-2.title: Proteios Cover | Baasim Fayaz Khan
cover-2.desc: Proteios Rollup Cover design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
paras: This rollup cover was designed for the Proteios Education seminars. It uses the institutional color palette and bold typography to create a high-impact visual presence for physical events.

The layout emphasizes legibility and brand recognition from a distance. By layering the core identity marks over a clean, professional background, the design ensures that the Proteios mission is immediately communicated to every attendee.

prime-design-logo.title: Prime Design Identity | Baasim Fayaz Khan
prime-design-logo.desc: Logo design for Prime Design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
paras: Prime Design is a minimalist creative direction mark that explores the intersection of strategy and visual art. Using the chessboard knight as its primary symbol, the logo communicates intelligence, non-linear thinking, and precision in creative execution.

The dark-mode execution with gold and white accents creates a premium, high-end feel suitable for a strategic design consultancy. The mark was designed to be effective even at the smallest scales, such as social media icons and watermarks.

proteios-logo.title: Proteios Identity | Baasim Fayaz Khan
proteios-logo.desc: Visual identity and logo design for Proteios Education by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
paras: The Proteios logo is a strategic blend of minimalist geometry and organic growth symbols. It was designed to represent the concept of "upward momentum" in education, using sharp lines to signify precision and a centered balance to represent institutional stability.
Built on a foundation of professional dark tones with vibrant growth-green accents, the identity communicates authority, innovation, and educational evolution.

thumbnail-1.title: 31 DAYS | Thumbnail Identity
thumbnail-1.desc: Detailed look at the '31 DAYS' YouTube thumbnail design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
paras: This thumbnail was created for a case study video tracking a YouTube channel's rapid growth over a 31-day period. It serves as a visual hook for viewers interested in analytics, strategy, and "challenge" style content.

The design process focused on three core psychological triggers: progress, validation, and urgency. I used a custom-drawn green growth line to lead the viewer's eye from the '31 DAYS' text directly to the phone mockup. High-saturation green was used for the accents to contrast against the dark background, ensuring the thumbnail stands out in a crowded feed.

thumbnail-2.title: INDIA | Thumbnail Identity
thumbnail-2.desc: Detailed look at the 'INDIA' YouTube thumbnail design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
paras: A strategic thumbnail designed for content analyzing the Indian market landscape. It uses high-impact visual metaphors to communicate growth and economic potential.

The design utilizes a vibrant national color palette with a modern, glassmorphic aesthetic. By layering financial symbols over a map of India, the thumbnail creates a clear narrative of economic advancement. The typography is bold and high-contrast to ensure legibility on mobile devices.

thumbnail-3.title: NO ADS | Thumbnail Identity
thumbnail-3.desc: Detailed look at the 'YOU DON'T NEED ADS' YouTube thumbnail design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
thumbnail-3.h2: YOU DON'T NEED ADS â€” Organic Growth Concept
paras: A provocative thumbnail designed for marketing content that challenges traditional advertising norms, focusing on organic reach and viral mechanics.

The "anti-advertising" theme is visually communicated through a stark, high-contrast black and yellow palette. This creates an immediate sense of warning and urgency. The large, bold typography uses a slightly distressed texture to feel more organic and less corporate.

thumbnail-4.title: HACKER GAMEPLAY | Thumbnail Identity
thumbnail-4.desc: Detailed look at the 'HACKER GAMEPLAY' YouTube thumbnail design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
paras: A gaming-focused thumbnail designed to capture the high-intensity atmosphere of competitive gameplay analysis.

The design utilizes "neon-glitch" aesthetics and sharp, aggressive typography to align with gaming culture. By centering the primary character silhouette and using radial lighting, the thumbnail directs all attention to the central theme, ensuring a high click-through rate among gaming enthusiasts.

thumbnail-5.title: 3 MILLION | Thumbnail Identity
thumbnail-5.desc: Detailed look at the 'KASHMIR GREAT LAKES' YouTube thumbnail design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
paras: A travel-documentary thumbnail designed to emphasize scale and massive viewership, using the '3 Million' milestone as a primary psychological hook.

The layout uses panoramic composition to emphasize the scale of the Kashmir Great Lakes trek. Oversized bottom typography ensures instant topic recognition even at small YouTube preview sizes. Saturation and clarity were pushed in the water and sky tones to create a crisp expedition feel.

thumbnail-6.title: HOW HE DID IT | Thumbnail Identity
thumbnail-6.desc: Detailed look at the 'HOW HE DID IT' YouTube thumbnail design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
thumbnail-6.h2: HOW HE DID IT â€” Success Story Concept
paras: A storytelling thumbnail designed for success analysis and case studies. It leverages curiosity-gap mechanics to drive engagement.

The design focuses on contrast and centered framing to create a sense of mystery and authority. By using a limited color palette of black, white, and a single accent color, the thumbnail maintains a clean, professional aesthetic while ensuring the primary hookâ€”the "How"â€”remains the focus.

thumbnail-7.title: THE TRUTH | Thumbnail Identity
thumbnail-7.desc: Detailed look at the 'THE TRUTH' YouTube thumbnail design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
paras: A high-impact investigative thumbnail designed to convey authenticity and "insider" knowledge. It uses intense facial expressions and dramatic lighting.

The design utilizes "over-the-shoulder" perspective to create an intimate, conspiratorial feel. Deep shadows and high-intensity lighting on the subject's face emphasize the seriousness of the topic. The bold "THE TRUTH" typography is placed at a slight angle to add dynamic energy to the frame.

thumbnail-8.title: DARK PSYCHOLOGY | Thumbnail Identity
thumbnail-8.desc: Detailed look at the 'DARK PSYCHOLOGY' YouTube thumbnail design by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
thumbnail-8.h2: DARK PSYCHOLOGY & MANIPULATION â€” Authority Concept
paras: A psychology-focused thumbnail crafted for content around influence, strategy, and behavioral analysis.

The design uses deep shadows, centered silhouette framing, and chessboard symbolism to represent control and decision power. Bold white title typography was intentionally kept dense and wide to maintain legibility against the dark scene while preserving the thriller tone.

x-club-logo.title: X Club Identity | Baasim Fayaz Khan
x-club-logo.desc: Logo design for X Club Fitness by Baasim Fayaz Khan.
x-club-logo.h2: X Club Fitness â€” Bold Athleticism
paras: Designed for a premier fitness center, the X Club identity uses high-contrast silhouettes and bold, industrial typography. The central 'X' serves as a crossroad of strength and discipline, while the athlete silhouette integrates directly into the mark to create an immediate visual connection to fitness excellence.
The monochromatic black-and-white execution was chosen to ensure maximum impact across physical signage, apparel, and digital media, reflecting the raw energy of high-intensity training.
